# List all source file paths
source_files = [

    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_50/test_13.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_50/test_14.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure emp_length is integer type
    df['emp_length'] = df['emp_length'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the same schema ['emp_length'] and target schema is the same,
# we can union (concatenate) all source tables vertically.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target table schema is ['emp_length'] with integer type, already ensured.

# Write the result to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_50/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
